definition: A JSON document with a Version and one or more Statements. Each statement has Effect, Action and Resource, plus optional Sid and Condition. Resource-based policies also require a Principal.
A browser-based shell in the console with the AWS CLI preinstalled. It uses your signed-in credentials, so no access keys, and keeps a small persistent home folder per Region.
Single-instance mode runs one EC2 instance with an Elastic IP, good for development. High availability mode adds a load balancer and Auto Scaling across several Availability Zones.
An application is the container of components; an application version is one deployable code bundle; an environment runs one version, such as dev or prod.
